content.json:
## RequestHub notification worker
The worker delivers the notifications that RequestHub creates when a request is submitted, commented on, rerouted, or decided. A healthy worker delivers each one within a few seconds.

The alert **RequestHub notification backlog** fires when the oldest pending notification is older than __THRESHOLD__ seconds. Azure SRE Agent picks it up and investigates. Start a drill only when every row below says Ready.

content.query:
resources
| where resourceGroup =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP__' and type =~ 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers'
| extend State = tostring(properties.state)
| project Order = 1, Check = 'Database', State, Ready = iff(State =~ 'Ready', 'Yes', 'No'), IfNotReady = 'Start the database server (README, Before each session)'
| union (resources
    | where resourceGroup =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP__' and type =~ 'microsoft.app/containerapps' and name =~ '__WORKER_APP_NAME__'
    | mv-expand env = properties.template.containers[0].env
    | summarize Faults = countif(tostring(env.name) startswith 'Faults__')
    | project Order = 2, Check = 'Worker fault', State = iff(Faults == 0, 'None', 'Injected'), Ready = iff(Faults == 0, 'Yes', 'No'), IfNotReady = 'python incident.py reset')
| union (alertsmanagementresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts' and tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule) =~ '__ALERT_ID__'
    | summarize Fired = countif(tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition) == 'Fired')
    | project Order = 3, Check = 'Backlog alert', State = iff(Fired == 0, 'Not fired', 'Fired'), Ready = iff(Fired == 0, 'Yes', 'No'), IfNotReady = 'Wait: it resolves after 3 healthy minutes')
| union (resources
    | where resourceGroup =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP__' and type =~ 'microsoft.app/agents'
    | extend State = coalesce(tostring(properties.powerState), tostring(properties.runningState))
    | project Order = 4, Check = 'Azure SRE Agent', State, Ready = iff(State =~ 'Running', 'Yes', 'No'), IfNotReady = 'Start the agent in sre.azure.com')
| order by Order asc
| project-away Order
content.title: Ready for a drill (Azure Resource Graph, refreshes within a minute of a change)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "requesthub.notifications.oldest_pending_age_seconds"
| summarize ["Oldest pending (s)"] = max(value) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Oldest pending notification (seconds). Alert threshold: __THRESHOLD__

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "requesthub.notifications.pending"
| summarize Pending = max(value) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Pending notifications

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "requesthub.notifications.processed"
| summarize Delivered = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 1m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Notifications delivered per minute

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Notification backlog"
| project timestamp, message
| order by timestamp desc
| take 20
content.title: Worker backlog reports (workerDelayFaultActive shows an injected fault)

content.query:
ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__WORKER_APP_NAME__"
| project TimeGenerated, Revision = RevisionName_s, Reason = Reason_s, Message = Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 30
content.title: Worker revisions and container events (a configuration change creates a new revision)
